content.comment_body: I want to confirm: if I connect an expansion module to the [product_name] controller, will the outputs on the expansion module be labeled Q5 to Q8, since the base controller already uses Q1 to Q4? Thanks for clarifying.

That is correct. With the first expansion module, the inputs are addressed as I9 to I12 and outputs as Q5 to Q8. Adding a second expansion module continues the sequence: inputs become I13 to I16, and outputs are Q9 to Q12.

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested confirmation on how outputs are addressed when attaching an expansion module to a [product_name] controller. The reply confirmed that both inputs and outputs continue sequentially as more expansion modules are added.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects output addresses on expansion modules to be sequentially numbered, following the outputs of the base controller.
